productName: SignRoute — Unlimited Digital Signatures & Sealed PDF Routing in Google Docs

shortVideo.fullText: Tired of signing agreements and routing sealed PDFs in Google Docs getting locked behind monthly subscriptions and external cloud portals? With SignRoute, Responsive HTML5 Signature Canvas in Docs runs right where you already work. Stamp at {{Signature}} Tokens or Cursor Position and Instant Sealed PDF Archival to Google Drive—100% under your own custody. Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.

demoVideo.fullText: Need a better way to handle signing agreements and routing sealed PDFs in Google Docs, without handing your data to another monthly cloud landlord? Watch SignRoute in action: Draw a smooth, high-DPI signature with your mouse, trackpad, or stylus right inside the Google Docs sidebar and save it for one-click reuse. Automatically place your signature graphic and cryptographic timestamp block at designated {{Signature}} tags or right where your cursor sits. Plus, compiles the signed Google Doc into a flattened, tamper-evident PDF and saves it directly into your chosen Google Drive contract folder. Your NDAs, vendor approvals, and equipment handoffs never sit on a third-party e-signature vendor's server—and you never pay per document. Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.
